title: Credit-Tier Schedule for the Collision Deductible — Insurer-Feed Proof Re-Review under Collateral Protection Insurance
content:
Collateral Protection Insurance raises the collision deductible ceiling in the re-review of an insurer-feed proof on a closed tracking record by a credit-tier allowance. The tier is the credit tier of the borrower's contract under Retail Installment Contracts, as the contract record shows it.

| Credit tier of the contract | Raise to the collision deductible ceiling |
|---|---|
| Tier 1 Select | USD 500.00 |
| Tier 2 Preferred | USD 500.00 |
| Tier 3 Advantage | USD 500.00 |
| Tier 4 Standard | USD 250.00 |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | USD 250.00 |
| any other tier | USD 0.00 |

The allowance is read from the contract's tier alone and concerns the collision deductible only.

**Hypothetical:** with a hypothetical plan ceiling of USD 800.00, a contract on Tier 3 Advantage has its collision deductible ceiling raised by USD 500.00, to USD 1300.00; the same proof on a Tier 4 Standard contract has it raised by USD 250.00, to USD 1050.00.
